streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Substrate and additive dissolved in solvent. Flow rate derived from calculation (Q_total = 0.5 mL/min) to achieve target residence time.
From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: H2 is separate gas stream. Flow rate from calculation (1.12 sccm) to ensure stoichiometric excess and mass transfer.

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Substrate/AcOH pre-mixed in liquid. H2 mixed with liquid feed immediately before packed bed to maximize gas-liquid contact time and solubility under pressure.
pre_reactor_steps: Mix liquid stream (Substrate/AcOH/MeOH) and gas stream (H2) in certified gas-liquid mixer.
Pressurize system to 20 bar using BPR to ensure H2 solubility and prevent degassing.
post_reactor_steps: Collect product stream (no quench required per Chemistry Plan).
chemistry_notes: Reaction is a catalytic hydrogenolysis of a benzylic C-N bond. Batch yield was low (38%) likely due to mass transfer limitations. Flow design uses a packed bed of Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 (stationary) to enhance gas-liquid mass transfer (kLa). Acetic acid additive included in liquid feed to enhance rate. H2 supplied as gas. No light source used. Temperature maintained at 60°C. BPR set to 20 bar (max inventory) to maximize H2 solubility and safety margin, exceeding the calculated minimum of 3 bar.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation estimated 6.0 min (range 2.2-45.0 min) based on 50x intensification factor for mass-transfer limited hydrogenation. Analogies 1-3 are photochemical and not directly applicable for kinetics, but support short residence times in flow. 6.0 min is conservative for initial screen.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. Using inlet/STP basis as per universal physics rules for gas-liquid designs where historical evidence suggests inlet residence time is standard for sizing. V = t_inlet * (Q_liq + Q_gas_STP).
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (60°C) per Chemistry Plan and Analogies 2 (which also used 60°C).
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation requires BPR > 1 bar for gas-liquid systems. Inventory allows 10 or 20 bar. Selected 20 bar (max inventory) to maximize H2 solubility (Henry's Law) and ensure safety, exceeding the calculated minimum of 3 bar.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: SS (Stainless Steel) per Inventory for packed bed reactor. Not photochemical, so transparency not required.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.1 M from Batch Input Step 1. Analogies did not specify concentration, so batch value retained.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Inventory constraint: Only 5 mL packed bed reactor available. Calculation suggested 11.2 mL, but inventory is authoritative. This results in a shorter residence time (5 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 10 min liquid-only, but gas volume reduces effective liquid residence time. Using calculation's 6 min target as design goal, actual RT will be ~10 min liquid equivalent, which is within the 2.2-45 min range).
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.5 mL/min from Calculation Step 9 to achieve target residence time with available reactor volume.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow_sccm: 1.12 sccm from Calculation Step 9 to provide stoichiometric H2 and maintain gas-liquid ratio.
